name: pc-live-map
title: PC Live Map — screenshot-free AI eyes + hands
description: Infinite OS tool v6 — future-grade, screenshot-free eyes + hands. Live vectors with UIA values: cursor 0-1000 + windows + 50 elements with value + focused with value + clipboard + idle + virtual screen. ~500-950 tokens at 4 Hz, 13-15x cheaper and 50x faster than screenshots. Text-only models drive it fully.
rule: ALWAYS read GET /api/live (or /api/agent) before acting on screen. NEVER take a screenshot when live.mode is os-live. Vectors ALWAYS — screenshot ONLY when zone=unknown or text lives inside a canvas/game/scanned PDF with no UIA names (say why in one line).

endpoints.agent: GET /api/agent — one fetch: instructions + live state + element values + focused value. START HERE.
endpoints.live: GET /api/live — full vector state v6 (mouse, fg, 20 windows, 50 UIA elements with value, focused with value, clipboard, seq, vscreen)
endpoints.elements: GET /api/elements?q=save — search clickable UIA elements by name substring (max 50, includes value)
endpoints.action: POST /api/action — queue one action for executor (validated, rate-limited 30/10s). Prefer click_name.
endpoints.events: GET /events — SSE stream of tracker packets + heartbeats

actions.note: BEST: no coords needed, server resolves UIA name to coords
coords ALWAYS norm 0-1000 on BOTH axes
max 500 chars, sent via clipboard paste (reliable)
SendKeys string, max 64 chars, e.g. ^s = ctrl+s, %{F4} = alt+F4
bring process window to front by name

agent_loop: GET /api/agent (or /api/live) — observe vectors, note seq + elements[]
If target has a name: POST /api/action {type:click_name, name} — else coords from elements[]
GET /api/live again — verify seq advanced + focused/cursor changed
coordinate_contract: norm 0-1000 on BOTH axes everywhere (tracker v4, /api/live, /api/action, executor v2). x_norm = px/screenW*1000, y_norm = py/screenH*1000.
one_click: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File pc-live-map/Start-LiveMap.ps1  (starts all three + opens UI)
privacy: 100% localhost. Tracker logs window titles + UIA names/rects + clipboard first 120 chars only. Never full keystrokes, never pixels. User starts/stops everything with Ctrl+C; Esc pauses browser recording.
